candidates.snippet: President Trump targets Democrat Abdul El-Sayed over questions surrounding his medical credentials before heading to a rally in Port Huron, Michigan. https://t.co/jJYPpcC2A9

"Ruthless Podcast" hosts zero in on Democrat Abdul El-Sayed as Michigan's Senate race draws national attention.

"He's caused some problems, and it seems like it's following him everywhere, isn't it?"

The hosts question El-Sayed's progressive politics as they discuss his matchup
